faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 2 December 2026, and candidates report at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NFSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Research Assistant (Temporary Basis), 1 Field Investigator (Temporary Basis).

faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 2 December 2026 at 11:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs.37,000 p.m for Research Assistant (Temporary Basis), Rs.20,000 p.m for Field Investigator (Temporary Basis).
